title: Weak page metadata
summary: Search and social previews are degraded due to missing or suboptimal title, description, and Open Graph tags.
problem: Search and social previews are degraded: page title (absent), meta description, Open Graph tags are missing or outside recommended lengths.
recommended_change: notes: Write a 15-60 char title and 70-160 char description per page; add og:title and og:image for link previews.
evidence: Measured on the homepage: title 0 chars (15-60 recommended); description 0 chars (70-160 recommended); og:title missing, og:image missing.
opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

title: Missing trust signals above the fold
summary: The homepage shows no sign of returns policy, guarantee, so a first-time visitor has nothing to offset purchase risk.
problem: The homepage shows no sign of returns policy, guarantee, so a first-time visitor has nothing to offset purchase risk.
recommended_change: notes: Surface review counts, the returns window and a guarantee near the primary call to action.
evidence: Measured on the live homepage: no match for returns policy, guarantee.
opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift
